verdict.rationale: Remote is a global payroll, EOR and contractor-management SaaS platform, not an AI agent or MCP host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is the wrong axis for this product type. The evidence shows only the opposite role: an official Remote MCP server and an agent-skills plugin that other clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI) plug in. That server-side evidence does not make the client-side axis apply.
